config.description: Symbolic MCP claim-verification eval: replay codebase claims mined from real Claude Code session traces and check whether the model routes each one to a well-formed Prolog goal

function.name: mcp__symbolic__parse
function.description: Parse a PROJECT and cache its codebase facts in memory, keyed by that project's own root. Omit path to discover a .symbolic/config.json by walking up from the server's cwd. A previously cached project is untouched by parsing a different one. Re-parsing the SAME project rescans it and replaces just that entry.

path.description: Project root (must have .symbolic/config.json inside) or any plain directory to scan literally

rules.description: Prolog rules file to consult instead of auto-discovering .symbolic/rules.pl

function.name: mcp__symbolic__query
function.description: Prove a Prolog goal against a cached codebase and return all solutions (capped). Raw facts, from `overview`: defines(Function, Arity, Params, File, Line), export(Function, Arity, File, Line), calls(Caller, CallerArity, CallSpec, File, Line) where CallSpec is local(Callee, ArgCount)/remote(Module, Function, ArgCount)/member(Object, Method, ArgCount), doc(Function, Arity, File, Line, Text), branch(Function, Arity, Kind, File, Line), comment/3, heading/4, paragraph/3, code_block/3, config_value/4, config_section/3. Prefer an existing derived predicate over reinventing it inline, when `parse`'s `rules_file` shows a library was consulted: callees/2, callers/3, undocumented/4, duplicate_name/3 (+all_duplicate_names/1), self_recursive/3, fan_out/3, fan_in/3, no_local_callers/3 (+all_no_local_callers/1), reaches/2, truly_uncalled/3 (+all_truly_uncalled/1 - excludes entry_point/3, so exported API and OTP callbacks are not dead code), real_complexity/4 (+too_complex_real/4, +all_too_complex_real/1 - real McCabe-style branch counting on branch/5, more accurate than too_complex/3's fan-out proxy), plus the markdown facts heading/4 for documentation claims.

goal.description: One Prolog goal over those facts, e.g. calls(X, _, local(parse, 2), File, Line), callers(parse, 2, File), or defines(scan_one, 1, Params, File, Line)

path.description: Which cached directory to query, by the same path passed to parse

function.name: mcp__symbolic__overview
function.description: Report the current state of a cached fact base: whether a codebase is loaded, how many files/languages, and fact counts by predicate.

path.description: Which cached directory to report on; omit for the most recently parsed

function.name: mcp__symbolic__ask
function.description: Answer a bounded English question against a cached codebase: does X/N call Y/M, which functions call X/N, how many functions call X/N, is X/N defined, where is X documented. Unverifiable questions come back as {type: unverifiable, reason}; phrasings outside the grammar are an unrecognized error. Callers that need anything the grammar does not cover should write a query goal instead.

question.description: The question, e.g. "how many functions call query_binary/2?"

path.description: Which cached directory to ask about; omit for the most recently parsed
